entries.name: Simon Hornby
entries.text:
A 90-year-old man goes for a physical and all of his tests come back normal. The doctor says, “Frank everything looks great. How are you doing mentally and emotionally? Are you at peace with God?”

Larry replies, “God and I are tight. He knows I have poor eyesight, so He’s fixed it so when I get up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom, poof! The light goes on. When I’m done, poof! The light goes off.”

“Wow, that’s incredible,” the doctor says.

A little later in the day, the doctor calls Larry’s wife.

“Bonnie,” he says, “Frank is doing fine! But I had to call you because I’m in awe of his relationship with God. Is it true that he gets up during the night, and poof, the light goes on in the bathroom, and when he’s done, poof, the light goes off?”

“Oh sweet Jesus”, exclaims Bonnie. “He’s peeing in the refrigerator again!”

entries.name: Gastón Fournier
entries.text:
A developer walks into a bar and orders 1 beer, then 10 beers, then 0 beers, then 999 beers.

The bartender asks, "Are you testing me?"

The developer replies, "No, QA is coming in next."
